author: Zeman, Z. A. B. (ed.)
title: Germany and the Revolution in Russia, 1915–1918: Documents from the Archives of the German Foreign Ministry
notes: The German documentary base for every subsequent argument about Berlin's subsidies to Russian revolutionaries — the papers the Foreign Ministry itself kept, printed in translation. Cited for what the German government said it was doing and why, which is not the same question as what the money did. The Internet Archive copy is a third-party upload whose rights status is not established; it is linked because it is what can be read, not as a rights-cleared edition.
